about: Material in this package derived from other works. Paths are relative to the package root; a path ending in / is a directory. 'notice' is required (the licence or terms ask for it), courtesy (attribution not required) or none. 'status' is ok, or decision while the terms of an entry are not settled (--strict then fails). third_party/gen_notices.py turns this file into NOTICES.

entries.title: Go standard library and Go sub-repositories (translated algorithms)

upstream.project: The Go Programming Language (standard library 1.26; golang.org/x/text v0.21.0; golang.org/x/crypto cryptobyte)

entries.text: These files translate algorithms of the Go standard library and of golang.org/x/text and golang.org/x/crypto into Rust so that results are byte-identical: the DEFLATE encoder and decoder with zlib and gzip framing, the PNG reader and writer, the baseline/progressive JPEG decoder and baseline encoder, decimal and floating-point parsing and formatting (including the table of powers of ten), quoting of strings, mathematical functions, the seeded pseudo-random source and its tables, path cleaning, JSON and XML tokenizers and printers, URL and media-type parsing, RFC 3339 times, sorting, certificate DER checks and the multi-byte character-set decoders. Modified: translated to Rust, error values adapted.

entries.title: Insight Toolkit (N4 bias correction, histogram matching, grayscale reconstruction, morphological watershed)

upstream.project: ITK (Insight Toolkit)

entries.text: Modified translations of itkN4BiasFieldCorrectionImageFilter, itkBSplineScatteredDataPointSetToImageFilter, itkBSplineControlPointImageFilter, itkHistogramMatchingImageFilter and Histogram::Quantile, itkReconstructionImageFilter, the regional-extrema, h-extrema and fill-hole filters and itkMorphologicalWatershedFromMarkersImageFilter. Changes: rewritten over dense float volumes with explicit neighbour offsets, budgets, cancellation, block-averaged estimation and the input checks listed in each file. Apache-2.0 section 4 requires the licence, ITK's NOTICE and a statement of changes in each modified file.

The code is written from the definitions and formats; no source was copied, so no licence notice is required.

entries.text: The codestream parser, packet decoder, tag trees, MQ decoder, tier-1 decoder and inverse wavelet transforms are a modified translation of this decoder. Added later from ISO/IEC 15444-1 and 15444-15: every progression order and POC, precincts, code-block styles, PPM/PPT, subsampling, reduction, quality layers, regions, RGN, HT code-blocks and resource limits.

entries.text: The codewords of the normative CxtVLC tables were obtained by inverting the decoder lookup tables of go-jpeg2000, which derive from OpenJPEG. Only the codeword data was used; the encoder and decoder are independent.

entries.text: The colour and opacity points and the lighting coefficients of three presets, as SLICER_CT_CHEST_CONTRAST_ENHANCED, SLICER_CT_CORONARY_ARTERIES_3 and SLICER_CT_MUSCLE (SlicerVrPreset) in src/render/vr_transfer.rs; VrTransferFunction::new_ct_muscle uses the CT-Muscle colours.
